skills.name: clarify
skills.natural: 요구사항이 모호하지 않게 필요한 질문만 한 번에 하나씩 물어봐줘.
skills.expected_output: one material question or a clarified handoff with sparse decision progress

skills.name: specify
skills.natural: 이 작업을 검증 가능한 요구사항으로 바꿔줘.
skills.expected_output: verifiable requirements with preserved user values and blocking decisions separated from defaults

skills.name: goal-draft
skills.expected_output: paste-ready /goal prompt under 4000 characters with success evidence and blocked behavior separated
required_terms: Do not mark this goal complete

skills.name: verify
skills.expected_output: PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED with a requirement-to-evidence mapping

skills.name: review
skills.natural: 이 diff에 ship blocker가 있는지 리뷰해줘.
skills.expected_output: severity-ordered findings or no findings with residual risk and unrun tests

skills.name: compound
skills.natural: 이번 실행에서 다음에 재사용할 근거 있는 교훈을 정리해줘.
skills.expected_output: reusable learning summary or authorized ledger/index updates without empty artifacts

subagents.name: code-explorer
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask for a bounded read-only source search and expect evidence with no edits.

subagents.name: docs-researcher
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask for authoritative project guidance and expect sourced facts, inference, and gaps.

subagents.name: gap-auditor
subagents.spawn_smoke: Pass a short draft and expect SUFFICIENT or CONTINUE with exactly one material question.

subagents.name: verifier
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask to verify a scoped claim and expect requirement-level PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED evidence.

subagents.name: code-reviewer
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask to review a diff and expect evidence-backed findings or explicit residual risk.

routing.handoff: audit whether material ambiguity still blocks a requirements or goal handoff
audit users, states, edge cases, constraints, verification, and blocking decisions
independently map material requirements to current evidence
independently inspect the review surface for behavior risks and test gaps
find authoritative learning stores, related human docs, and local naming rules
